source.question: Why did well F-12 decline faster after 2010? Compare with the 2005 development plan.

submission.summary: F-12's faster decline after 2010 most likely reflects injection water breaking through around early 2010 and taking its liquid capacity, consistent with the 2005 plan's forecast of breakthrough after about 2 years. After mid-2010 it averaged 72% lower oil rate than before and then declined at about 0.45 per year, while the field stayed inside its design liquid, oil and water-handling limits but reached its design water cut of 0.80 in 2012.

findings.claim: F-12 reached 5% water cut 21 months after first oil and then averaged 72% lower oil after 2010-07-18 than before, a gradual shift.
findings.detail: F-12 first oil 2008-02-12 (E1). Threshold 5% median water cut on 2009-10-31, 20.6 months after first oil (E2). Water_cut shift around 2010-02-14 weekly mean 0.0273 -> 0.513 (+0.49), across 0.22 -> 0.31 (+0.08 points) (E2). Threshold 50% on 2010-06-04, 27.69 months after first oil (E2). Oil regime around 2010-07-18 weekly mean 4,050 -> 1,146 Sm3/d (-72%) from period before to period after; across 4 weeks each side 2,352 -> 1,838 Sm3/d (-22%); choke 54.2% -> 51.18% moved false (E2). Plan: 'Vannproduksjonen kommer først og fremst fra injeksjonsvannet som bryter gjennom i brønnene etter omlag 2 år.' [Water production comes primarily from injection water that breaks through in the wells after about 2 years.] (E5) and cumulative about 6 MSm3 at breakthrough 'På det tidspunkt er kumulativ oljeproduksjon omlag 6 MSm3' (E14). Field actual 2008+2009 4.44 MSm3 (E16).

findings.claim: The decline after mid-2010 was consistent with water taking the well's capacity with liquid held and choke unchanged, and pressure was not lost.
findings.detail: By year liquid 4,740 Sm3/d in 2009 at water cut 0.0229 -> 5,130 Sm3/d in 2010 at water cut 0.5711 (E4). Across 2010-07-18 choke 54.2% -> 51.18% choke_moved false (E2). Exponential fit 2010-07-19 to 2012-12-09 qi 1,796 Sm3/d di 0.4461 per year r2_log 0.8727 no warnings (E9) vs early poor fit r2_log 0.019 (E8). BHP reads 0 from 2010-10-12 but flowed 1,830 days making 1,133,053 Sm3 oil, last good 253.9 bar on 2010-10-11 sensor failure not collapse (E2). Field voidage replacement ratio 1.08 in 2010 near 1 (E4).

findings.claim: Production logs show water came mainly from lower completions and a 2010 plug set in blank pipe at 3,210 m did not restore oil.
findings.detail: PLT 2009-03 ~83% oil from upper 2 completions (E12). PLT 2010-09-22 water cut 0.6307 before survey: oil 3,132-3,165 mMD, water 3,165-3,243 mMD (E12). At blank pipe 3147-3161 m below_top oil_share 0.814 water_share 0.981, below_bottom 0.768/0.925 (low rate); 3180-3220 m below_top 0.01/0.333 below_bottom 0.013/0.313 (E12). Plug at 3,210 m on 2010-09-23: water cut 0.638 -> 0.676, oil 1,850 -> 1,612 Sm3/d (E12). Latest survey 2,151 days old at 2016-08-12 with water cut 0.6307 -> 0.8779 now (E12).

findings.claim: The field stayed within design liquid, oil and water-handling capacities but reached the design maximum water cut of 0.80 in 2012.
findings.detail: PUD Table 4.3 limits: liquid 13,000 Sm3/d 'Væskekapasitet 13000 Sm3 /d', oil 9,000 Sm3/d 'Oljekapasitet 9000 Sm3 /d', max water cut 0.80 'Maksimum vannkutt 0,80', water handling 10,400 Sm3/d (E6/E14). Field max liquid 11,438 Sm3/d in 2014-06 (0 months at or above), oil 8,924 Sm3/d in 2008-12 (0 months), water 9,070 Sm3/d in 2014-10 (0 months), injection 17,206 Sm3/d in 2008-12 (3 months) (E6). Water cut first at or above 0.80 in 2012-06, max 0.861 in 2016-04, 27 months at or above (E6). PUD plateau 9,000 Sm3/d for ~19 months 'Platåraten på 9.000 Sm3 /d vil vare om lag 19 måneder' (E14).

result.no_trend: WOR is not rising with cumulative oil on 2013-05 to 2016-08: no limit can be projected
result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. The water cuts in to_limits are reference points, not an economic limit: the data holds no costs or prices, so remaining_oil_sm3 says how much oil is left before each, not whether it pays. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.

result.note: These are field and platform limits (PUD p.35 lists the same platform capacities); compare them with field totals, never one well. The maximum water cut is a share at full liquid rate: the water the platform can handle is liquid capacity x maximum water cut (water_sm3_per_day). The field reaching that share at a lower liquid rate means it ran at the design water cut, not over its water capacity. Rates are per calendar day of each month.

surveys.read_from: LAS files of the interpreted log (Well_logs_pr_WELL/15_9-F-12/10.PRODUCTION LOGS/PLT Sept 2010)

result.note: A production log measures the flow passing each depth while the well flows; going up, it grows past each zone that produces. A share at a depth is the part of the pass's oil or water entering below that depth (1 at the bottom of the well's inflow, 0 above the top zone). comes_in_from_m to to_m holds 90% of each phase's inflow. Only shares are given: the files' rates have no units, and the plots' are downhole volumes. A plug set at a depth shuts off what enters below it: the shares below say what it could remove, not what it did; plugs_set gives what each plug already set did to the well (water cut and oil before and after). A bridge plug is set in blank pipe, never inside a perforated interval (inside_perforation_m names the interval a depth falls in; blank_pipe_m lists the gaps, and each pass's at_blank_pipe gives the shares below the top and the bottom of every gap: the depths a plug can actually be set at). since_survey says how old the latest log is and how far the water cut has moved since: an old log may no longer show where the water enters, and a new one would settle it. Each survey's passes were run at several surface rates. A survey read off pictures carries the checks of that reading.

volve_pud.title: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation)

rows: The process plant on the jack-up platform is designed for the following capacities: oil production 9,000 Sm3/d, rich gas 1.5 MSm3/d, water treatment 10,400 m3/d, gas lift 0.45 MSm3/d, total liquid treatment 13,000 m3/d and water injection 16,000 m3/d.
Prosessanlegget på den oppjekkbare plattformen er designet for følgende kapasiteter.
The table row shows water treatment 10,400 m3/d and gas lift 0.45 MSm3/d as design capacities.
The table row shows total liquid treatment 13,000 m3/d and water injection 16,000 m3/d as design capacities.
Total væske behandling | 13.000 m3/d | Vanninjeksjon | 16.000 m3/d
The gas is transferred in a 7.4" pipeline via subsea template D on the Sleipner Øst field and further to the SLA facilities.
Gassen overføres i en 7.4" rørledning via havbunnsramme D på Sleipner Øst feltet og videre inn til SLA anleggene.
The field water injection capacity is 16000 Sm3/d.
The field maximum water cut is 0,80.

The injection compressor has sufficient capacity for simultaneous gas lift and injection into the D subsea template so that production does not need to be choked down during a production shutdown at Sleipner A.
Injeksjonskompressoren har derfor tilstrekkelig kapasitet til samtidig gassløft og injeksjon i D-bunnrammen slik at produksjonen ikke behøver å strupes ned ved produksjonsstans på Sleipner A.
The platform maximum water content design capacity is 80 %.
The platform water injection rate design capacity is 5.000 – 16.000 Sm3/d.
The platform water injection pressure design capacity is 330 bara.

document.title: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation)

result.text: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve Februar 2005 23 regularitet på 94 % er lagt til grunn for beregning av produksjonsprofilene. Gassløft er inkludert for å sikre oppstart av brønner etter vedlikehold og sikrer produksjonen hvis kommunikasjonen i reservoaret er dårligere enn antatt. Tabell 4.3 - Felt begrensninger Antatt produksjonsstart mars.2007 Væskekapasitet 13000 Sm3 /d Oljekapasitet 9000 Sm3 /d Gass kapasitet 1,5 M Sm3 /d Vanninjeksjons kapasitet 16000 Sm3 /d Maksimum vannkutt 0,80 Maks gassløft rate 0,45 MSm3 /d Antatt produksjonsstart mars 2007 er basert på kontrakten med Maersk. På grunn av værrisiko ved utslep kan produksjonsstart bli utsatt.. Tabell 4.4 - Brønn begrensninger Oljerate 2500-4500 Sm3 /d Minimum Oljerate 100 Sm3 /d Minimum brønnhodetrykk 40 bar Maks gassløft rate 0,15 MSm3/d 4.5.1 Prognose for oljeproduksjon Feltet vil bli startet opp når første brønn er klargjort og etter en oppstartsperiode på ca. 1 år vil feltetprodusere på platårate. Platåraten på 9.000 Sm3 /d vil vare om lag 19 måneder. Produksjonen avtar grunnet økende vannrate. Kumulativ oljeproduksjon inntil minimum økonomisk rate på 2.100 Sm3 /d (gitt Volve oljepris på 18,7 USD/fat) nås er 11,4 MSm3 . Oljerate og kumulativ produksjon er vist i figur 4.2. Denne er basert på forventet produksjon (snitt) estimert fra usikkerhetsstudiet, se kapitel 4.6. Figur 4.2 - Volve oljerate og kumulativ produksjon 4.5.2 Prognose for vannproduksjon Vannproduksjonen kommer først og fremst fra injeksjonsvannet som bryter gjennom i brønnene etter omlag 2 år. På det tidspunkt er kumulativ oljeproduksjon omlag 6 MSm3 . Behovet for vann fra Utsira-formasjonen for injeksjon er ca 12.000 Sm3 /d. Når vannproduksjonen øker, reduseres behovet for Utsiravann. Produsert vann og injisert vann er vist i figur 4.3.
result.summary_en: Page 23 of the Volve PUD presents field and well constraints (Tabell 4.3 and 4.4), assumed production start March 2007, and forecasts for oil production and water production including plateau rate, cumulative volume, economic cutoff, and figure 4.2 for oil rate and cumulative production.

The field will start up when the first well is completed and after a start-up period of about 1 year it will produce at plateau rate.
Feltet vil bli startet opp når første brønn er klargjort og etter en oppstartsperiode på ca. 1 år vil feltetprodusere på platårate.
The plateau rate of 9.000 Sm3/d will last about 19 months.
Platåraten på 9.000 Sm3 /d vil vare om lag 19 måneder.
Cumulative oil production until the minimum economic rate of 2.100 Sm3/d at a Volve oil price of 18,7 USD/fat is 11,4 MSm3.
Kumulativ oljeproduksjon inntil minimum økonomisk rate på 2.100 Sm3 /d (gitt Volve oljepris på 18,7 USD/fat) nås er 11,4 MSm3

Water production comes primarily from injection water that breaks through in the wells after about 2 years.
Vannproduksjonen kommer først og fremst fra injeksjonsvannet som bryter gjennom i brønnene etter omlag 2 år.
At the time of water breakthrough the cumulative oil production is about 6 MSm3.
På det tidspunkt er kumulativ oljeproduksjon omlag 6 MSm3
The need for water from the Utsira formation for injection is about 12.000 Sm3/d, decreasing as water production increases.
Behovet for vann fra Utsira-formasjonen for injeksjon er ca 12.000 Sm3 /d. Når vannproduksjonen øker, reduseres behovet for Utsiravann.
